query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM occurrences o
                JOIN reservations r ON r.id = o.reservation_id
                WHERE o.resource_id = $1
                  AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
                  AND r.status IN ('confirmed', 'pending')
                  AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR r.id <> $4)
                  AND o.start_time < $3
                  AND o.end_time > $2
            ) AS "exists!"
